title: Change the platform's default storage
summary: Change… on the Default row of Storage per player: the value is a live platform default, so the dialog names every product with Cloud Sync on and who in each uses the default, then confirms with a passkey.
compare: Opened only from the Default row, which carries the Platform pill; the title says the scope ("for every product?").
The field shows the new value with its unit and the current one ("Now 256 MiB").

Every product with Cloud Sync on is listed by logo and name with who uses the default there and how many have data (DJDL: Standard and Studio, no one has synced yet; Diceroll: Standard, 1,402 players, 3 over 80% today) and who keeps their own; products with Cloud Sync off aren't listed.
It says when it applies (each person's next sync) and the per-product alternative (give the tiers their own value).
The passkey step-up is announced before the button; the button says what happens and to how many: "Change the default for 2 products".
Only platform admins reach this dialog; a product role sees Change… disabled (config.cloud-sync-product-role).
The screen is one viewport behind the dialog. Phone: the dialog fills the width under the top bar and the buttons fill it too.
Spacing and copy pass (2026-10-08): the screen sets no spacing of its own (kit primitives only), and each fact shows once, where it's most useful.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.

findings.issue: The dialog repeated itself and the footer pattern differed on phone.
findings.resolution: Title names the scope ("in every product"); intro and footer merged into one sentence; removed the passkey line and added a fingerprint icon to the button; one phone footer pattern.

findings.issue: Neutral primary on dialog commit buttons (UX4)
findings.resolution: declined: Contradicts the kit's accent system. Gold for approve, red for destructive and the service accent for service actions are deliberate.
